correctness.rationale: Both estimators and the oracle budget are explicitly defined. Conditional Gaussian quadratic-form variance gives 2 E tr(B^2), and three ordinary probes give 2/3 tr(A^2). The projector trace identity gives B^2 trace=3+2(lambda-1)u+(lambda-1)^2u^2 exactly. Chi-square angular density gives rational E u and E u^2 by differentiating a known rational integral. Algebra yields explicit variances, variance-difference quintic, one positive root by Descartes and strict ratio derivative. The package verifier reproduced symbolic integral, characteristic polynomial sign, 25 exact projector cases, 10 independent quadrature checks and 5 simulations. Random experiments only corroborate, not prove, the all-lambda formula. Boundary lambda=1 and scaling s>0 are included.

originality.rationale: The novelty candidate is only the exact dimension-four, three-query Gaussian Hutch++ variance law, its ratio versus three Gaussian Girard--Hutchinson probes, and the unique algebraic crossover. The prior qualitative flat-versus-spiked spectrum tradeoff and conditional variance formula are explicitly acknowledged. Relevant full-text sections of Meyer et al., Persson et al., Jiang et al., Epperly et al., and Saibaba et al. were inspected and did not state or directly evaluate the integral into the closed crossover. Public mathematical-record searches returned nearby randomized projection and Hutchinson-diagonal claims, none implying this trace-estimator comparison. This is a qualified self-review originality assessment, not an assertion of exhaustive priority.
residual_risks: A prior exact small-spectrum integration may be hidden in a table, appendix or alternate trace-estimation terminology not returned by searches.
Generic conditional-variance identities in XTrace/Hutch++ are prior and are not claimed original; only their explicit 4x4 evaluation and crossover are new here.
Other probe distributions can reverse the method ordering; the result deliberately compares standard Gaussians only.

value.rationale: The fixed three-product comparison is the smallest dimension (4) in which exactly computing an unrestricted trace by coordinate basis exceeds the budget. Whether to spend scarce products on a deflation sketch or on more independent probes is a central algorithmic choice; the literature identifies the tradeoff qualitatively but not its sharp finite-budget threshold. The exact crossover is a natural complete parameter classification and a reproducible benchmark for spectral adaptivity. It does not claim a new algorithm, universal advantage, or global optimal query count.
